'''2001 I-10 Cup (August)''' was a Star Wars CCG i-10 cup (two-day sanctioned constructed event) held in Tucson, Arizona (day 1, 18 August); Gamerz Edge, Chandler, Arizona (day 2, 19 August) on 18 August 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2902">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01d2902/ viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 27 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-viper-tells-all-phoenix-az-8-19-01d2902/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Tucson, Arizona (day 1, 18 August); Gamerz Edge, Chandler, Arizona (day 2, 19 August)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
